title: ClusterRecord
description: Hop dong du lieu giua clustering (Nam) va query-api / incident view (Nghia). Moi cum loi sau khi cham diem bat thuong duoc luu theo dinh dang nay.

cluster_id.description: Dinh danh duy nhat cho mot cum loi tuong tu

service.description: Ten service cua cac log thuoc cum nay (mot cum chi gom log cua dung 1 service - xem compute_anomaly_score). Dung de facet theo service o Dashboard.

signature.description: Dac trung dung de nhom (vi du: message da chuan hoa hoac hash cua stack trace)

score.description: Anomaly score - muc do lech so voi baseline tan suat lich su

log_ids.description: Danh sach id cac log thuoc cum nay, dung de Incident View truy ve trace/request

trace_ids.description: Danh sach trace_id duy nhat lien quan den cum, dung cho lien ket trace/request

status.description: normal: diem duoi nguong. anomalous: vuot nguong nhung chua gui alert. alerted: da gui alert
